caption:
A catgirl hunter crashes the vampire mafia.
Pure Seedance 2.5, from rooftop to throne.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: high-end 2D Japanese anime thriller, crisp cel-shaded characters with thin dark line art and colored rim lights (red, magenta, teal), painterly backgrounds, heavy bloom, haze and film grain. Night neon palette: cold teal and cyan city light outside, hot magenta-pink smoke and neon inside, warm orange chandelier and muzzle-flash light during the fight. Camera feel: aggressive and kinetic, low angles, fast dives and tracking moves, slow menacing push-ins on faces, white and magenta strobe flash cuts on impacts. Pacing: fast and chaotic, 3 quiet tension beats (eyes, seduction, throne) broken by bursts of extreme action. Stylized anime blood splashes only, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE HUNTER: an adult woman (about 28), tall and athletic, pale skin, very long straight black hair with a blue-violet sheen falling to her thighs, two pointed black cat ears on top of her head, sharp red eyes with thin slit pupils, small white fangs, a cold sly smirk. Outfit: a black high-cut bodysuit with a high mandarin collar and a small gold clasp at the throat, a long oversized white coat worn open and slipping off her shoulders that flares like wings when she moves, black thigh-high stockings with gold buckle garters, black heeled boots, long black claw-like nails. Signature details in every shot: the cat ears, the flaring white coat, the red slit eyes, and a black hexagonal device strapped to her left wrist with a small gold glyph on it. Weapons: a katana on the rooftop and at the end; two short daggers, one in each hand, during the club fight and the corridor.
- THE MOBSTER: a middle-aged man (about 50), tanned skin, slicked-back black hair greying at the temples, heavy jaw, nervous sweating face. Black suit, white shirt, black tie.
- THE BOSS: a broad heavy-set man (about 55), short dark hair, thick heavy eyebrows, pale icy-blue eyes, dark burgundy-black suit, seated like a king.
- THE SYNDICATE: dozens of men in identical black suits, white shirts and black ties, some with pistols; the boss's guards wear dark tactical gear and helmets and stand in silhouette.

LOCATIONS: (1) a flat rain-slick rooftop at night above a dense modern skyline of glowing office and apartment towers with pink, purple and white neon signs, storm clouds overhead. (2) a vampire mafia nightclub on the glass-roofed top floor of a skyscraper: dark polished floor, red-lit walls, thick pink-magenta smoke, a huge golden crystal chandelier with candle lights. (3) a long narrow dark corridor with teal-green glowing wall panels and bright magenta neon strips running along both upper edges, small neon signs on the walls, reflective wet floor. (4) a throne room: a golden ornate throne in the center against a wall of glowing magenta neon signs, purple-lit floor.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:00.3) — The drop. Wide, locked-off, from the far end of the rooftop: the hunter falls feet-first from the top of the frame toward the roof, coat and hair streaming upward, the skyline behind her.
SHOT 2 (00:00.3-00:01.1) — The landing. Same wide frontal view, low angle: she lands in a deep crouch at the center, the concrete cracks under her boots in a spiderweb, rain splashes up, the white coat flares wide on both sides, katana held low in her right hand, hair blown up with teal rim light. Tiny settle push-in.
SHOT 3 (00:01.1-00:02.4) — The eyes. Extreme close-up of her eyes filling the frame, slow push-in: red irises with slit pupils, rain streaking past, her face split by light — hot magenta on the left, bright teal-green neon on the right, black hair framing it.
SHOT 4 (00:02.4-00:03.4) — The dive. Top-down aerial shot over the skyscrapers; one tower's rooftop is a glass roof glowing magenta with a crowded party visible inside. The camera dives straight down at high speed toward the glowing glass roof, motion blur, rain lines.
SHOT 5 (00:03.4-00:06.2) — The entrance. Inside the club, in thick pink-magenta smoke: low tracking shot at hip height in front of her as she walks forward between two walls of men in black suits, then the camera tilts up and pulls back into a medium-wide frontal shot: she walks slowly toward the lens, coat open, cat ears up, a confident smirk; the suited men on both sides stare at her, rows of them fading into the smoke behind.
SHOT 6 (00:06.2-00:09.6) — The touch. Medium close-up two-shot, locked-off: the mobster on the left facing the lens, the hunter on the right in profile, leaning in to his ear with a fanged smile. Her black-clawed hand slowly strokes his jaw. He sweats and stares ahead, a puff of breath leaves his mouth. MUST SHOW: the black hexagonal wrist device on her wrist, right under his chin; at 00:08.3 its gold glyph lights up glowing red.
SHOT 7 (00:09.6-00:12.4) — The laser. Same two-shot. MUST SHOW: a thin bright red laser beam shoots horizontally out of the wrist device, straight across the mobster's throat and off the right side of frame. He freezes, eyes wide, a thin glowing red line left across his neck; he slowly slumps down out of frame. She turns her head away with a cold smile, alone in the frame. MUST SHOW: a heavy cut-crystal whiskey tumbler tumbles through the air in slow motion in the left foreground, catching the pink light.
SHOT 8 (00:12.4-00:14.3) — The chandelier. Low angle on the giant golden crystal chandelier with glowing candle lights, then the camera tilts down into a wide shot of the room: she stands alone under the chandelier in the center while dozens of suited men around her open fire, big orange muzzle flashes on both sides, the pink smoke lit up; bullet sparks rain onto the floor around her, then a burst of electric-blue light flares at her hands.
SHOT 9 (00:14.3-00:15.3) — Strobe. Rapid flash cuts: the frame blows out to bright magenta-white with black silhouettes of gunmen in the foreground, then flashes of her in a wide crouched stance with a dagger in each hand and a bright cyan arc of light sweeping across the right edge of frame.
SHOT 10 (00:15.3-00:18.6) — The massacre. Wide, low, handheld-feeling tracking around her in the club: she leaps and spins in the air over a gunman, the white coat swirling around her like a disc; she spins overhead across the chandelier; she lands and slashes through the men with both daggers, red blood sprays and pools across the dark floor, men collapse. A glowing orange-edged black table flips up and flies straight at the camera from the left, filling the frame with black (wipe transition).
SHOT 11 (00:18.6-00:20.1) — The corridor charge. In the teal-and-magenta corridor: she sprints straight at the lens low to the floor, coat billowing behind her, a dagger in each hand held out to the sides, red eyes glowing. Camera tracks backward fast at floor level.
SHOT 12 (00:20.1-00:20.5) — Profile flash. Close-up from the side as she runs past: her fanged grin, a red eye, hair and white coat streaming; then a dark smear of motion blur.
SHOT 13 (00:20.5-00:23.8) — The ceiling run. Deep one-point-perspective shot down the corridor, two armed guards in tactical gear at the far end. She runs upside-down along the ceiling at the top of the frame, coat hanging down. A dark figure passes the lens. Both guards burst into huge clouds of red blood mist as she passes overhead inverted. She flips down and lands in a crouch with her back to the camera, the white coat spreading on the floor around her, red streaks on the wet floor.
SHOT 14 (00:23.8-00:26.5) — The throne. Symmetrical locked-off wide shot, very slow pull-back: the boss sits on a golden ornate throne in the center, glowing magenta neon signs behind him; armed guards in tactical gear stand in black silhouette in a row on both sides; the purple floor glows.
SHOT 15 (00:26.5-00:27.0) — His eyes. Extreme close-up of the boss's eyes: heavy brows lowering, icy-blue eyes narrowing.
SHOT 16 (00:27.0-00:27.2) — The strike. Flash cut: a horizontal red laser slash streaks across the whole frame, red blood splashes across the lens, she is glimpsed through it, glowing eyes.
SHOT 17 (00:27.2-00:28.9) — The reveal. Low-angle full frontal shot: she stands where the throne was, in front of the magenta neon signs, white coat flaring out wide, long hair floating up around her, katana lowered in her right hand. Slow push-in.
SHOT 18 (00:28.9-00:30.1) — Final face. Close-up of her face, cat ears framing it, glowing red eyes, a wide fanged grin, magenta neon glowing behind her. Slow push-in, then cut to black.

SOUND: heavy dark synthwave and trap beat with deep sub-bass, building through the whole clip, no vocals. Shots 1-3: rain hiss, distant city hum, a heavy concrete crack on the landing, a low growl of bass. Shot 4: wind roar of the dive, glass shattering. Shots 5-7: muffled club bass, murmurs, a soft electric hum as the wrist device charges, a sharp laser zap, a glass tinkling as it tumbles. Shots 8-10: deafening gunfire, ricochets, blade whooshes, slashes, bodies falling, a table crashing. Shots 11-13: fast footsteps, a whoosh, wet bursts, a heavy landing. Shots 14-15: the music drops to a low drone, a deep breath. Shot 16: laser slash and a wet splash. Shots 17-18: a big final bass hit, then a low throaty laugh from her. No dialogue.
prompt_short: 2D anime thriller, neon night. A pale catgirl hunter in a white coat and black bodysuit drops onto a rainy rooftop, crashes a vampire mafia club, lasers a mobster, slashes through gunfire under a chandelier, runs on a corridor ceiling, ends at the boss's throne.
